_meta.label: Sex cord–stromal tumour

settings.label: Stage I–II after surgery: adjuvant therapy vs observation
Newly diagnosed stage II–IV or residual disease: primary chemotherapy
Recurrent disease (any interval): surgery, chemotherapy, endocrine, targeted

tiers.1: Not used: no OS benefit shown in any SCST trial
tiers.5: Randomised SCST comparison with no efficacy difference: chosen on toxicity (GOG-0264, ALIENOR)
tiers.6: Single-arm SCST trial, registry or paediatric series
tiers.7: Do not use: no objective responses in prospective SCST trials, or superseded

_meta.summary: Two small randomised SCST trials exist (GOG-0264 first-line, ALIENOR at relapse); neither showed a survival difference, so their arms rank on toxicity. Everything else is single-arm or registry data, ranked by subtype, age, ER/PR and resectability, then toxicity.
_meta.tier_reading: Tier 5 = GOG-0264 (paclitaxel–carboplatin vs BEP: PFS HR 1.11, futility; G≥3 80% vs 90%) and ALIENOR (weekly paclitaxel ± bevacizumab: no PFS or OS gain). Tier 6 = single-arm SCST trials, registries and paediatric series, including endocrine therapy (prospective ORR 0–10.5%; a disease-stabilisation option) and repeat cytoreduction (largest effect size, OS HR 0.28, in a surgically selected cohort). Tier 7 = agents with no objective responses in prospective SCST trials and superseded regimens. Subtype drives adjuvant decisions: AGCT stage IC has no dataset showing benefit; SLCT risk sits in differentiation and heterologous elements; JGCT risk in stage ≥IC2 or mitoses >19/10 HPF.

regimens.name: Observation after complete surgical staging

os.median: Stage IC GCT: NCDB adjusted OS HR 1.07 (0.52–2.21) with vs without chemotherapy; SEER adult GCT IC DSS 97% vs 94% (P=0.491); meta-analysis mortality OR 0.83 (0.44–1.57). Stage I JGCT (MITO-9): no recurrences after fertility-sparing surgery

qualifiers: No randomised adjuvant trial exists in any SCST histotype
Incomplete surgical staging is the consistent adverse factor (recurrence HR 3.883; death HR 1.84): restage rather than treat blindly

prefer_when.reason: Stage I AGCT: no dataset shows benefit from adjuvant chemotherapy
Stage I JGCT without high-risk features / well-differentiated SLCT IA: no recurrences in the series

risk_rules.reason: SLCT with mesenchymal heterologous elements: all stage I patients without chemotherapy recurred by 24 months; recurrence HR 74.18 without vs 1.21 with chemotherapy (unadjusted)
Intermediate / poorly differentiated SLCT: relapses concentrated here (6/7 in G2–3, MITO)
JGCT FIGO ≥IC2 or mitotic index >19/10 HPF: 3-yr EFS 63.6% (IC2–IC3), 48% (II–IV)
Observation data are mostly stage I

os.median: SLCT stage I with mesenchymal heterologous elements: 3-yr OS 35.7% without chemotherapy vs 98.5% without heterologous elements; registry suggests chemotherapy neutralises the risk (unadjusted)

pfs.text: SLCT 3-yr RFS IA 93.6%, IC 67.1%, II–IV 60.6%; stage IC AGCT DFS 87.5% vs 76.3% (P=0.197)

qualifiers: NTUH BEP is a 3-day schedule (cisplatin 100 D1, etoposide 100 D1–3, bleomycin 15 mg/m² over 24 h D1–3), not the GOG schedule

prefer_when.reason: Registry authors suggest chemotherapy for all SLCT with mesenchymal heterologous elements

risk_rules.reason: Stage IC AGCT: no dataset shows benefit (NCDB OS HR 1.07; meta-analysis OR 0.83)

regimens.name: Secondary (repeat) cytoreductive surgery

tox_ref.note: Surgical morbidity not reported in the note

os.median: AGCT registry: secondary cytoreduction vs systemic therapy alone, median OS 181.9 vs 61.6 mo, OS HR 0.28 (0.11–0.67); restricted to resectable disease without medical barrier (surgically selected)

pfs.text: PFS2 31.8 vs 13.6 mo (HR 0.42); MITO-9: 5-yr OS 87.4% without vs 55.6% with residual tumour after repeat surgery

qualifiers: Largest effect size in SCST relapse, but in a surgically selected cohort; aim for no residual tumour

prefer_when.reason: Resectable recurrence: OS HR 0.28 in the registry

risk_rules.reason: Not resectable: residual tumour after repeat surgery carried 5-yr OS 55.6%
